label: Transconductance at the bias point
subgoals: Read the bias current and overdrive from the operating point
Compute gm as twice the current over the overdrive
Use the model derivative in place of the formula for short-channel devices

label: Output resistance
subgoals: Read lambda and the bias current
Compute the output resistance as one over lambda times the current
Stamp gm, gds and the capacitances at the frozen operating point

label: Intrinsic gain
subgoals: Simplify to two over lambda times the overdrive
Use the intrinsic gain to sanity-check simulated stage gains
